content.outro: The lamp is still there, across the water, where it was meant to be seen from.
content.premise: A stone jetty runs out into open sea. Far off to the east, on a rock of its own, a lighthouse keeps a lamp lit at noon. The jetty was built to look at it from.
content.theme: A jetty, open water, and a lamp on the horizon.
content.title: The Lamp Across the Water
